$comment: Compatibility sweep round 17 list (compiled by desktop compat sweep round 12, the first list a desktop round compiled, and measured on the desktop by that round on Electron 44.4.5, baseline ff730181; Android compat round 20 takes it as compiled): the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json and the 30 of each of next30-round3.json to next30-round16.json (ranks 481-510; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round17/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-09-26; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count, equal rounded rating counts by name. Candidates came from the store's category listings and keyword searches, about 26,550 detail pages probed across rounds 3 to 17 (this round added 548 search terms and 1,642 new detail pages; six of them read the rounded 300,000 bucket or above - Pix Companion at 2,000,000 users and 213 ratings, My Doodle at 1,000,000 and 426, Bark for Chrome at 1,000,000 and 150, Plasma Integration at 500,000 and 298, Save All Resources at 400,000 and 392, Ready X at 300,000 and 65.5K - counts that would have placed the rankable ones in earlier lists had the store's listings or the earlier rounds' terms surfaced them, so the three rankable ones above the 400,000 bucket are ranks 481-483 as the highest-count items not yet listed, the earlier lists standing as compiled, and Save All Resources and Ready X take their places inside their buckets by their rating counts; the other 1,636 are below the bucket). Every unlisted candidate at or above the rounded 300,000 bucket (161 detail pages) was read again on 2026-09-26, the day of this list's read; twelve user counts had moved since their last read and the list ranks the re-read figures - five items up from the 300,000 bucket into the 400,000 bucket (Bonjourr · Minimalist New Tab Page, Diccionario RAE en un clic 2022, Google Meet Breakout by Robert Hudek, TickerIQ Crypto Price Ticker, SkrivaText), two down from 300,000 to 200,000 (Web Highlights, Link Grabber - below this round's cut), and five organisation-managed items up one bucket (ClassLink OneClick Extension 17,000,000 to 18,000,000, Mobility Print 10,000,000 to 11,000,000, LearnPlatform for Students 4,000,000 to 5,000,000, Britannica School Insights 900,000 to 1,000,000, Securly for Chromebooks 600,000 to 700,000). Ranks 481-483 are the newly surfaced pages' rankable items above the 400,000 bucket in count order, the 1,000,000 tie by rating count - My Doodle (1,000,000, 426 ratings), Bark for Chrome (1,000,000, 150) and Plasma Integration (500,000); Pix Companion is the filter Pix's certification sessions switch on for a test's duration on the machines the sessions run on, organisation-managed as the earlier lists held MasteryConnect LockDown Browser; the rounded 700,000 and 600,000 buckets still hold no unlisted rankable item (Securly for Chromebooks, Idira Identity Browser Extension and Citrix Web Extension organisation-managed, Dark Theme for Google Chrome a theme, Postman a Chrome App), nor the 500,000 bucket beyond Plasma Integration (Sea Foam a theme, Cegid Peoplenet ClickOnce launcher organisation-managed). Ranks 484-497 are the rounded 400,000 bucket's 14 rankable items by rating count after the 18 of next30-round14.json, the 29 of next30-round15.json and the 25 of next30-round16.json - Bonjourr (24.2K), Diccionario RAE (403), Save All Resources (392), Google Meet Breakout (132), EditThisCookie (V3) (94), Scrible Extension (91), Yahoo Homepage (75), Shopify Scraper & Parser (54), Maps Scraper by Presto (47), SAML-tracer and TickerIQ Crypto Price Ticker (36 each, ordered by name), Speed Test for Chrome (31), Read AI (30) and SkrivaText (3) - which leaves the bucket without a rankable item (Omnissa Horizon URL Content Redirection Helper, CXone Agent WebRTC Extension, iboss Classroom Management for Students and Chrome Reporting Extension organisation-managed). Ranks 498-510 are the rounded 300,000 bucket's 13 items with the most ratings, Ready X (65.5K) to Youtube Playback Speed Control (4.3K), and the cut falls between Youtube Playback Speed Control at 4.3K ratings and PureVPN Proxy - Best VPN for Chrome at 4K; no two of the 13 share a rounded rating count. Plasma Integration is KDE's companion to the plasma-browser-integration host over native messaging, ranked as earlier lists ranked the native-messaging companions (its core check stops at the host's absence). Bark for Chrome is Bark's monitoring agent on a child's browser, signed in to the parent's Bark account (no popup and no options page; its core check stops at the account gate); SkrivaText, Shopify Scraper & Parser, Maps Scraper by Presto and PocketTube ask for an identity, Scrible, Read AI, Liner, Mino, SwagButton and J2TEAM Security their services, Ready X is a Starknet wallet and anonymoX a proxy service - ranked as earlier lists ranked Grammarly and HubSpot Sales. Four rows replace the new-tab page (chrome_url_overrides.newtab: Bonjourr, Yahoo Homepage, Infinity New Tab (Pro), Speed Dial 2 New tab); none carries chrome_settings_overrides. The rows carry the manifests' names, which match the store's listings for 29 of the 30; Speed Test for Chrome - WiFi speedtest is listed as Speed test for Chrome - wifi speed test. Not ranked: themes (Morpheon Dark, Dark Theme for Google Chrome, Sea Foam), Chrome Apps (Google Classroom, Postman), organisation-managed or organisation-login-only items (the list of round 16's comment - ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Mobility Print, Endpoint Verification, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students, OpenText Content Server Browser Web Extension, My Apps Secure Sign-in Extension, MasteryConnect LockDown Browser, HID Credential Management Extension, Snow Web Application Metering, iboss Cloud Connector, LanSchool Web Helper, Browser Security Plus, Browser Redirection Extension, ActivID CMS extension, Britannica School Insights, Securly for Chromebooks, Idira Identity Browser Extension, Citrix Web Extension, Cegid Peoplenet ClickOnce launcher, iboss Classroom Management for Students, RapidIdentity, Omnissa Horizon URL Content Redirection Helper, CXone Agent WebRTC Extension, Chrome Reporting Extension - and Pix Companion) and Google items whose detail pages publish no user count.
